name: Dungeon Raider
description: In dungeon raider you are a dwarf hunting for treasure in some very haszardous mines; stuck in a cycle of making gains and spending on upgrades for the rest of your life.
contribution: I did some heavy boilerplate work, the biggest things was a sort of sequencer/timer/animator that allowed for more dynamic behaviors and animations.
I was also the only one to do enemy work, so the design, implemtation, and sprites for the 3 enemies (seen on slide 3) were designed by me!
I was the only person who worked on audio, so all sfx, and the OST were done by me.
notes: This is the project where I learned that it's not wise to grind out an entire audio engine and sound effects in one day, I have no idea how I managed to finish it and get sleep the same night.
